question: Should `models.providers.*.request.headers.*` plaintext auditing use the shared header-name sensitivity classifier, instead of treating every plaintext request header as a secret-bearing finding?
rationale: This choice trades a real Wafer-ZDR/static-routing false positive against possible false negatives for neutral-named custom credential headers, so automation should not choose the security policy by itself.

options.title: Approve shared classifier
options.body: Accept the same header-name heuristic for request headers, then refresh the draft branch and merge after ordinary gates pass.

options.title: Narrow the suppression
options.body: Require the PR to suppress only documented static routing headers or expand the sensitive-name classifier before merge.

options.title: Pause or close the draft
options.body: Keep the current conservative audit behavior until maintainers define a safer request-header credential contract.

recommendation.title: Approve shared classifier
recommendation.body: Accept the same header-name heuristic for request headers, then refresh the draft branch and merge after ordinary gates pass.
